name: Zero Balance
tagline: The fastest, cheapest route out of debt, with the maths
about: Zero Balance goes deeper than a budget app on debt: avalanche, snowball and hybrid payoff orders with real dates and interest totals, a consolidation reality check, creditor letters, monthly progress check-ins and what minimum payments really cost.
persona: You are a no-shame debt coach: precise with interest maths, practical about motivation, never judgemental, and you flag when free debt-advice services or a regulated adviser are the right next step.

onboarding.title: Every debt has an end date
onboarding.subtitle: List what you owe once; every tool uses it.

profile.label: Extra you can pay per month

tools.title: Payoff order
tools.subtitle: Avalanche, snowball or both
tools.prompt: Using the profile debts and extra monthly payment, apply '{method}'. Table (Order | Debt | Balance | APR | Paid off by | Interest paid), kv (debt-free date, total interest, months saved vs minimums only), text on why the order is set that way, and a callout on the motivation trade-off between the two methods.

tools.title: Is consolidation worth it?
tools.subtitle: One loan vs the current plan
tools.prompt: Compare consolidating the profile debts into one loan at {rate}% APR (default 12) over {term} months (default 48) with {fee} in fees (default 0), versus the current avalanche plan. Table (Option | Monthly payment | Total interest + fees | Debt-free date | Risk), bullets on when consolidation backfires, a checklist of what to verify in the offer, and a callout on balance-transfer promo traps.

tools.title: Write to a creditor
tools.subtitle: Hardship, freeze, settlement, dispute

inputs.label: Your situation
inputs.placeholder: lost hours at work, can pay 60/month for 6 months

tools.prompt: Write a '{type}' letter given: {situation}. Creditor: {creditor} (if not given, address it to the account provider with a placeholder for the name). Sections: quote with the full letter (formal, factual, with a specific amount and dates), bullets on what to attach, steps for what happens next and when to follow up, and a callout naming the kinds of free debt-advice services available in the profile country in general terms.

tools.title: Monthly check-in
tools.subtitle: New balances → updated end date
tools.prompt: Monthly progress check {months} months in (default 1). Balances now: {balances}. Feeling: {feel}. Compare against the profile debts and extra payment: table (Debt | Starting balance | Now | Paid down | Est. months left), kv (total paid down, interest saved so far vs minimums only, updated debt-free date, ahead or behind the original plan by N months). Then text with an honest, encouraging read on pace that matches how it feels, and a callout with the single focus for next month.

tools.title: What minimums really cost
tools.subtitle: One debt, the ugly truth
tools.prompt: For {debt}, show the cost of paying only the minimum. Sections: kv (years to pay off at minimums only, total interest at minimums, months if 50 more per month, months if 100 more per month), table (Extra per month | Payoff months | Interest saved) for 0, 25, 50, 100, 200, text explaining how minimum payments are designed to keep you paying, and a callout on the first move to make this week.

disclaimer: General education only — not financial, tax or legal advice. Figures are illustrative projections, not predictions; check your own situation with a licensed adviser.
